column1: # eur: hand-made USA -> EUR addresses, for what dev/eur/map.py can't map (or
# maps to something that isn't what the override means). Read by
# dev/eur/translate.py after map-eur.tsv; a line here wins.
# TalkExpander::ExpandMessage(const wchar_t*) became, in the EUR build, a
# wrapper (0x001C0478) that reads Corrin's gender and tail-calls the new
# r0 (this) and r1 (the line) unchanged. randomizer.c rewrites r1 before the
# expansion, so it replaces the gendered one: every line passes through it,
# from the wrapper and from callers that give a gender themselves.
